ignoreCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] || [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" ] || [ "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then exit 1; fi; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; if git -C "$root/frontend" diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" -- .; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
